t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. N’sedeya, n’mari ko I’ye n’da le ke I’long aning ka I’batu. N’sonta n’na sembeng tang ya la aning I’te la bungba ya, N’fua re ya anina I’la bana ya. Ala koteng mang soto fo I’te, I’dembari la, I’meng ye I’fang tarandi.
